title: Existence of compatible restriction of a local cocone
statement: Let R, p, A = R_p [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], K, χ : κ_R(p) → K, q and ψ : κ_A(q) → K [def-weil-residue-field] satisfy the parent hypotheses: the evaluation through ψ is the specified A-algebra map into K, and its restriction to R is evaluation through χ. Use pointed étale triples [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples] and the compatible-leg relation [new-def-sbc-etale-triples-prime-localization-cocone-relation]. For every ring V and local cocone θ, there exists a global cocone η satisfying the compatible-leg relation.

source.place: Tag 04GW; Section 10.9, Proposition 10.9.3; Tag 00U2 (3). The cocone reduction is an agent-written consequence, not a verbatim theorem.

proof.text: Work first with any ring map ℓ : R → A and compatible pointings into the field K. For a global triple s, construct P_s as the ring pushout of s.α and ℓ, with maps ι_s : s.B → P_s and α_s : A → P_s. Compatibility of the two maps to K gives b_s : P_s → K by pushout.desc. The affine pushout square is a scheme pullback (Mathlib isPullback_SpecMap_pushout), so α_s is étale by stability under base change [lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-base-change]. The Mathlib equivalence SpecToEquivOfField identifies Spec.map b_s with a prime r_s and residue-field map φ_s; applying the inverse equivalence and Spec.map_injective proves evaluation followed by φ_s equals b_s. Precompose with α_s to obtain the base-pointing compatibility. Apply Spec.map to that equality and evaluate at the closed point of Spec K to prove r_s lies over q. Thus P_s defines a local triple t_s, with s.α ≫ ι_s = ℓ ≫ t_s.α and ι_s followed by its pointing equal to the pointing of s.

For a compatible pointed ring map β : s.B → t.B into any local triple t, let δ : P_s → t.B be pushout.desc β t.α, using the structural-map compatibility. The pushout equations give α_s ≫ δ = t.α and ι_s ≫ δ = β. The equality of δ followed by the pointing of t with b_s follows by pushout.hom_ext: on s.B it is the pointing compatibility of β, and on A it is the compatibility of t. Hence δ defines a morphism t_s → t of local triples in the induced under-over category.

Define η.app s = ι_s ≫ θ.app t_s. For a global morphism f : s → s′, extract its structural-map and pointing equations from Under.w and Over.w. The preceding pushout construction applied to the composite s.B → s′.B → P_s′ gives a local morphism a : t_s → t_s′ with ι_s ≫ D.map a = D_global.map f ≫ ι_s′. Naturality of θ for a, together with associativity, proves naturality of η. For each β in the compatible-leg relation, the preceding δ gives a : t_s → t with ι_s ≫ D.map a = β. Naturality of θ for a proves β ≫ θ.app t = η.app s.

Specialize A to Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal and ℓ to the canonical localization map. Rewrite the local base pointing using hψ; hK gives the required equality of pointings on R. Apply the proved generic pushout construction and cocone restriction to obtain exactly the stated existential and compatible-leg relation.
